info.title: Ogami API
info.description: JSON API of the Ogami solo tabletop RPG companion.

post.summary: Sign in and start a session

200.description: Signed in; the response sets the HttpOnly session cookie.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or misses a field.

429.description: Too many failed attempts; try again later.

204.description: Signed out (also when there was no session).

200.description: The signed-in player's campaigns, newest first.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

post.summary: Create a campaign pinned to the latest release of a GameSystem

201.description: The new campaign; the Location header is its URL.

Location.description: The URL of the new campaign.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, has no string "name" or "gameSystemKey", or a "flowKey" that is not a string.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: The GameSystem has no published release, or its latest release has no Flow with this key.

409.description: The generated campaign id is already taken.

422.description: The name is blank or too long.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

post.summary: Start the next session of one of my campaigns

201.description: The campaign, the new session current and without a scene.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: The campaign already holds the most sessions it can, or another request changed it meanwhile.

post.summary: End the current session of one of my campaigns

200.description: The ended session. No scene starts until the next session.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: No session is under way (none has started, or it has ended), or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

post.summary: Start the next scene in the current session of one of my campaigns

201.description: The campaign, the new scene current.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed: neither a string "title" nor a string "sceneType", or one of them is not a string.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Scene Type with this key.

409.description: No session is under way (none has started, or it has ended), the current session holds the most scenes it can, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

422.description: The title is blank or too long.

post.summary: Switch the Scene Type of the current scene of one of my campaigns by hand

200.description: The current scene with its new Scene Type; its number, title and journal entries stay.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "sceneType".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Scene Type with this key.

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, the current scene is a hook Scene, or another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

put.summary: Set the value of a Tracker of one of my campaigns by hand

200.description: The Tracker with the value kept, clamped to its range.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no integer "value".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no Tracker with this key.

409.description: Another request changed the campaign meanwhile.

get.summary: List the GameSystems a campaign can be created with

200.description: The latest published release of each GameSystem, by name ignoring case, then key.

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

get.summary: Read the journal of one of my campaigns

200.description: Every entry, in recording order (then id order).

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

post.summary: Write a note in the current scene of one of my campaigns

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "text".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, or the generated entry id is already taken.

422.description: The text is blank or too long.

post.summary: Roll dice on the server and record the roll in the current scene of one of my campaigns

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "expression".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id.

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, or the generated entry id is already taken.

post.summary: Roll on an oracle table of the pinned release and record the result in the current scene of one of my campaigns

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no oracle table with this key.

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, or the generated entry id is already taken.

post.summary: Ask a likelihood oracle of the pinned release and record the answer in the current scene of one of my campaigns

400.description: The JSON body is malformed: no string "likelihood", a non-integer "chaosFactor" or a non-string "question".

403.description: The user is not a solo player.

404.description: No campaign of the player has this id, or its pinned release has no likelihood oracle with this key (or not the Tracker its chaos is bound to).

409.description: The campaign has no current scene, or the generated entry id is already taken.

422.description: The likelihood level is unknown, the chaos factor is out of range or not expected (also when the oracle takes it from a campaign Tracker), or the question is too long.

post.summary: Ask a likelihood oracle a yes/no question

200.description: The answer, the roll and the effective target it was compared with.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, has no "oracle" object (a non-empty JSON list is not one) or no string "likelihood", or a non-integer "chaosFactor".

422.description: The oracle is invalid, it has no such likelihood level, or the chaos factor is out of range or given without chaos.

post.summary: Roll on an oracle table, following nested tables

200.description: Every table rolled on, root first, with the dice, total and selected entry.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed, or has no "tables" list (a JSON object is not one) or no string "table".

422.description: The tables are invalid, none has the key asked, or a roll matches no entry.

200.description: The roll: its total and every die rolled, dropped ones included.

400.description: The JSON body is malformed or has no string "expression".

422.description: The expression is not valid dice notation, exceeds a limit or divides by zero.

get.summary: Report whether the API and its database are up

200.description: The API is up; the database status is reported separately.

error.description: A human-readable message; never says whether an email exists.

releaseVersion.description: The release version the campaign is pinned to.

gameSystemKey.description: A GameSystem from `GET /api/play/game-systems`; the campaign is pinned to its latest release.

flowKey.description: A Flow of that release to play along; absent or null to play freely (the release's default Flow is not applied).

kind.description: A scene of play, or a hook Scene.

sceneType.description: The key of the scene's Scene Type; null for a hook Scene or a scene without one.

sceneTypeName.description: The name of the scene's Scene Type in the pinned release.

hook.description: The hook a hook Scene records; null for a scene of play.

scenes.description: In number order; empty right after the session starts.

endedAt.description: When the session ended; null while it is under way.

key.description: The likelihood to ask the oracle with.

chaos.description: Null when the oracle takes no chaos factor.

chaosTracker.description: The key of the campaign Tracker whose value is the chaos factor, so no chaos factor is sent; null when the player picks it.

upTo.description: The highest value of the level; null for the last level, which catches the rest.

min.description: The lowest value; 0 for a clock.

max.description: The highest value; the number of segments for a clock.

segments.description: The number of segments of a clock; null for a counter.

levels.description: The named ranges of a counter, in order; empty for a clock.

levelLabel.description: The label of the level the value falls in; null without levels.

description.description: Null when the Flow has none.

introduction.description: Shown when the campaign starts; null when the Flow has none.

default.description: Whether this is the release's default Flow (at most one is).

defaultView.description: How a campaign playing it opens.

currentSessionNumber.description: The session under way: the latest one unless it has ended; null before the first one or once it ends.

currentSceneNumber.description: The latest scene of the current session; null when it has none yet.

oracleTables.description: The oracle tables of the pinned release, in definition order.

likelihoodOracles.description: The likelihood oracles of the pinned release, in definition order.

trackers.description: The Trackers of the pinned release with the campaign's values, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

flowKey.description: The key of the Flow the campaign plays; null when played freely.

flows.description: The Flows of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

sceneTypes.description: The Scene Types of the pinned release, in definition order; empty for schema version 1.

StartSceneRequest.description: A title, a Scene Type, or both.

title.description: Trimmed; not blank. Optional with a Scene Type: the scene is then named after it, numbered per Scene Type in the campaign ("Legwork 2").

sceneType.description: The key of a Scene Type of the campaign's pinned release.
The key of a Scene Type of the campaign's pinned release.

value.description: Clamped to the Tracker's range (min..max, 0..segments for a clock).

key.description: The key to create a campaign with.

description.description: Null when the Flow has none.

default.description: Whether this is the release's default Flow (at most one is), to preselect.

gameSystemKey.description: The key to create a campaign with.

description.description: Null when the release has no description.

version.description: The version a new campaign is pinned to.

flows.description: The Flows a new campaign can play, in definition order; empty for schema version 1 (a campaign is always played freely then).

value.description: The face the die landed on.

kept.description: Whether the die counts towards the total; false when a selector dropped it.

dice.description: Every die rolled, in roll order, dropped ones included.

subtotal.description: The sum of the kept dice.

total.description: The value of the expression, counting kept dice only.

groups.description: Every dice group, in notation order; empty when the expression rolls no dice.

dice.description: The normalized notation rolled: the table's dice, or "1dW" for a weighted table of total weight W.

total.description: The total rolled, which selected the entry.

text.description: The selected entry's text; may be empty when the entry nests a table.

nestedTableKey.description: The table the next step rolls on; null on the last step.

steps.description: Root table first, then each nested table rolled.

question.description: The question asked; null when none was given.

answer.description: Yes when the roll is at most the effective target, no otherwise; exceptional within the oracle's exceptional bands.

effectiveTarget.description: The level's target shifted by the chaos factor and clamped to 0…sides.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level asked with.

chaosFactor.description: The chaos factor used (the neutral one when none was given); null when the oracle has no chaos.

expression.description: Dice notation, rolled on the server (same grammar as `POST /api/rolls`).

likelihood.description: The key of one of the oracle's likelihood levels.

chaosFactor.description: Within the oracle's chaos range; omitted or null for its neutral factor. Must be omitted or null when the oracle has no chaos.

question.description: Trimmed; omitted, null or blank for no question.

target.description: The highest roll that answers yes at the neutral chaos factor; 0 to sides.

LikelihoodChaosDefinition.description: The effective target is the level's target + (chaosFactor − neutral) × shiftPerPoint, clamped to 0…sides; min ≤ neutral ≤ max.

neutral.description: The chaos factor used when none is given.

shiftPerPoint.description: Target points added per chaos point above neutral; 0 to sides.

LikelihoodOracleDefinition.description: Rolls 1d<sides> = R against the effective target T: yes when R ≤ T. With p = exceptionalPercent, the yes is exceptional when R ≤ floor(T × p / 100), the no when R > sides − floor((sides − T) × p / 100).

levels.description: The likelihoods a question can be asked with; unique keys.

chaos.description: Absent when the oracle has no chaos factor.

exceptionalPercent.description: Size of the exceptional bands, in percent; 0 by default.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level to ask with.

chaosFactor.description: Within the oracle's chaos range; the neutral one when absent. Only allowed when the oracle has chaos.

answer.description: Yes when the roll is at most the effective target, no otherwise; exceptional within the oracle's exceptional bands.

effectiveTarget.description: The level's target shifted by the chaos factor and clamped to 0…sides.

likelihood.description: The key of the likelihood level asked with.

chaosFactor.description: The chaos factor used (the neutral one when none was given); null when the oracle has no chaos.

OracleTableEntryDefinition.description: Ranged entries have "min" and "max"; weighted entries may have a "weight" (1 by default). An entry needs a "text" unless it nests a "table".

min.description: Lowest total this entry covers, on a ranged table.

max.description: Highest total this entry covers, on a ranged table.

weight.description: Relative chance of this entry, on a weighted table; 1 by default.

table.description: The key of a table of the set to roll on next when this entry is selected.

OracleTableDefinition.description: A ranged table has "dice" and entries with "min" and "max" that do not overlap; a weighted table has no "dice", entries with an optional "weight" and rolls 1dW for total weight W.

key.description: Unique within the table set: a-z, 0-9 and "-".

dice.description: Dice notation rolled on a ranged table; absent on a weighted table.

tables.description: The table set: unique keys; nested tables must be in the set, never cycle and nest at most 10 levels deep.

table.description: The key of the table to roll on.

dice.description: The normalized notation rolled: the table's dice, or "1dW" for a weighted table of total weight W.

total.description: The total rolled, which selected the entry.

text.description: The selected entry's text; may be empty when the entry nests a table.

nestedTableKey.description: The table the next step rolls on; null on the last step.

table.description: The key of the table rolled on first.

steps.description: One step per table rolled, root first; a step with a nestedTableKey is followed by the roll on that table.

expression.description: Dice notation: NdM, "d%", keep/drop selectors (kh, kl, dh, dl, k), integers, + - * / and parentheses. Case-insensitive; whitespace ignored.

value.description: The face the die landed on.

kept.description: Whether the die counts towards the total; false when a selector dropped it.

dice.description: Every die rolled, in roll order, dropped ones included.

subtotal.description: The sum of the kept dice.

expression.description: The normalized notation: lower case, no whitespace, "d" as "1d", "d%" as "d100", "k" as "kh".

total.description: The value of the expression, counting kept dice only.

groups.description: Every dice group, in notation order; empty when the expression rolls no dice.

database.description: Whether the database answers right now.
